description: This file defines the AnnotationException class within the Drupal Component Annotation Doctrine namespace, providing various static methods to generate specific exception instances related to annotation processing errors.

classes.name: AnnotationException
classes.description: Custom exception class for annotation-related errors, extending PHP's Exception class, with static methods for specific error scenarios.

methods.name: syntaxError
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating a syntax error in annotations.

methods.name: semanticalError
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating a semantical error in annotations.

methods.name: creationError
methods.description: Creates an exception for errors during annotation creation, optionally with a previous throwable.

methods.name: typeError
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating a type error.

methods.name: semanticalErrorConstants
methods.description: Creates an error for missing constants during annotation processing.

methods.name: attributeTypeError
methods.description: Creates an error for attribute type mismatches in annotations.

methods.name: requiredError
methods.description: Creates an error for missing required annotation attributes.

methods.name: enumeratorError
methods.description: Creates an error for invalid enumerator values in annotations.

methods.name: optimizerPlusSaveComments
methods.description: Creates an error indicating that opcache.save_comments or zend_optimizerplus.save_comments must be enabled.

methods.name: optimizerPlusLoadComments
methods.description: Creates an error indicating that opcache.load_comments or zend_optimizerplus.load_comments must be enabled.
